summary: The class and id attributes give CSS a way to pick specific elements. Use a class for a group of elements and an id for one unique element.
notes: id="president" must appear only once on the page.
class="officer" is on three paragraphs, so one CSS rule styles all three.
class="officer new" gives one element two classes. It gets the styles of both.
pitfall: Using the same id on two elements. The page still shows, but it is invalid HTML and links like href="#president" only find the first one.
